title: Getting started with vicrental
text: Compare suburbs. Choose three suburbs, property type number bedrooms. plot shows median weekly rent new lettings quarter, one line per suburb. Hover line see quarter, median rent number new lettings. Top 10 rankings. Choose year, quarter, property type number bedrooms, choose whether rank least expensive suburbs. Use slider show 3 10 suburbs. Bars coloured region. Affordability. Set weekly rent budget, property type, number bedrooms many recent quarters average . table lists suburbs whose average rent budget. Click column header sort, use search box find suburb. combination data, example house one bedroom, app shows message instead empty chart.

title: Getting started with vicrental
text: Median rent middle weekly rent new rental agreements suburb quarter. describes new tenants pay, existing tenants. New lettings number new rental agreements quarter. rent based lettings less reliable. Compare suburbs: line sits another expensive suburb. shorter line means suburb reported data missing quarters. Top 10 rankings: top bar expensive lease expensive. Colours show regions, can see whether expensive cheap suburbs cluster one area. Affordability: rent average quarterly median rents chosen period, approximation, exact median. Suburbs quarters data less reliable. Suburb can single suburb group suburbs, Carlton-Parkville.

title: Tools and Shiny App for Exploring Victorian Rental Data
text: vicrental helps renters Victoria explore rental prices suburb. includes cleaned dataset, functions summarise rank rents, Shiny app answers: rents changed, suburbs least expensive, can afford live?

title: Tools and Shiny App for Exploring Victorian Rental Data
text: rentals dataset contains median weekly rents number new lettings flats houses across Victorian suburbs, quarter number bedrooms. Source: Victorian Department Families, Fairness Housing (DFFH) Rental Report, compiled https://publicdata.au/d/vic-rents--suburb/. Preparation: data-raw/rentals.R reads raw CSV, removes aggregate rows (“properties”, “Group Total”) rows missing values, splits property description number bedrooms property type, derives year quarter. Columns: see ?rentals.

title: Find suburbs within a budget — affordable_suburbs
text: Averages suburb's median weekly rent recent quarters data, chosen property type number bedrooms, keeps suburbs whose average budget.

title: Find suburbs within a budget — affordable_suburbs
code: affordable_suburbs(   data = vicrental::rentals,   budget,   property_type,   bedrooms,   quarters = 4,   min_quarters = min(1, quarters),   n = Inf )

title: Find suburbs within a budget — affordable_suburbs
text: data data frame columns rentals. Defaults rentals. budget Maximum weekly rent dollars (number). property_type Either "Flat" "House". bedrooms Number bedrooms (integer). quarters Number recent quarters average . Defaults 4. min_quarters Minimum number quarters suburb must data . Defaults 1, quarters smaller. n Maximum number suburbs return. Defaults Inf, returns .

title: Find suburbs within a budget — affordable_suburbs
text: tibble columns suburb, region, avg_rent (average quarterly median rents), avg_lettings (average period) n_quarters (quarters data), ordered cheapest expensive. zero rows suburb within budget.
